scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, capture receipts, and every receipt-listed screenshot tile; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; tools/autopilot/AUDIT.md read for category-audit context.
review_method.rendering: Every receipt-listed PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaling.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every assigned frozen title and full ItemBody was reviewed in the snapshot and compared with the byte-identical current source, assigned local HTML, capture receipt, and screenshot tiles.
review_method.boundary: No item, application, publication-status, or live-site edits; no builds, tests, gates, commits, pushes, or network calls. Only lane-08.md and lane-08.json were written.

rendering_findings.kind: source Markdown heading rendered as body text
rendering_findings.rationale: The source places `## Sources` on the same physical line as the final proof paragraph, so the local HTML prints the heading marker literally after the conclusion instead of rendering a section heading. This is a definite presentation defect; the quotient-averaging map itself is displayed legibly.
rendering_findings.concrete_map_or_relation: The statement and proof concern the averaging map T_H:C_c(G)→C_c(G/H), with T_H f(xH)=∫_H f(xh) dh; the issue is the final proof/source-section boundary after that proof.

rendering_findings.kind: source Markdown heading rendered as body text
rendering_findings.rationale: The source places `## Sources` on the same physical line as the final proof paragraph, so the local HTML prints the heading marker literally after the conclusion instead of rendering a section heading. This is a definite presentation defect; the intertwining map and Radon–Nikodym formula are displayed legibly.
rendering_findings.concrete_map_or_relation: For equivalent quotient measures, U(F)=w^{-1/2}F intertwines Π_ρ and Π_ν; the proof gives D_g^ν(q)=w(g^{-1}q)D_g^ρ(q)/w(q). The issue is the final proof/source-section boundary after this relation.

limitations: Local screenshot and HTML review only; no live routes or full mathematical correctness review.
